source.html:
Grandma's Fudge
 
Save Print
Author: Grandma G.
Recipe type: American
Cuisine: Dessert
Ingredients
  • 4 cups sugar
  • 8 Tablespoons cocoa powder
  • 8 Tablespoons light corn syrup
  • 1¼ cups whole milk
  • 1½ Tablespoons butter
  • 1½ cups of walnuts (optional)
Instructions
  1. Mix sugar and cocoa powder together.
  2. Mix all of the ingredients in a large sauce pan. Heat over medium-high, stirring constantly until the mixture boils. Do not stir after this point.
  3. Turn down heat to medium-low and cook to 237 degrees Fahrenheit. Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm in a pan of ice water. Do not disturb.
  4. Beat until the mixture isn't runny but before is sets up. You can tell if the fudge is beginning to set up if some candy dribbled from a spoon forms a mound instead of blending in.
  5. Add 1½ cups of walnuts if desired.
  6. Pour onto greased, waxed paper or onto a greased counter top. Cut before fudge sets.
